observed_pattern.description: The checksum-bound daily archive create_time appears consistently one 5-minute bucket earlier than the connected endpoint timestamp for the same underlying observation. For open interest, archive 23:45 equals connected 23:50 exactly; archive 23:50 equals connected 23:55 exactly; archive 23:55 equals connected 00:00 exactly. Ratio endpoints additionally expose fewer decimals than the archive, so exact floating-point equality is not a valid source contract for those fields even after timestamp alignment.
observed_pattern.precision_observation: Daily archive ratios contain more decimal precision than connected public ratio endpoints, which are rounded to about four decimal places. A validated precision-aware comparison is required; raw values must remain unchanged.

gate_effect: No promotion. source_freshness=false and live_feature_parity=false until the archive/connected timestamp semantics and precision mapping are verified over a broader overlap sample and the full causal pipeline passes twice at independent observation times.
next_bounded_step: Verify archive create_time versus connected endpoint timestamp semantics across multiple overlapping rows/days. If the period-end versus period-start mapping is confirmed, implement it only in normalization while preserving immutable raw timestamps/values. Use exact comparison for open-interest fields and a justified precision-aware comparison for rounded ratio fields, then rerun the first fresh full-pipeline receipt.
